steps.name: the time each new ticket is due, in hours after its creation
steps.sql: SELECT id, CAST(ROUND((julianday(sla_due_at) - julianday('now')) * 24) AS INTEGER) AS hours FROM tickets WHERE created_by LIKE 'agent:%' ORDER BY id

steps.name: spread the new tickets out in time
steps.sql: UPDATE tickets SET created_at = datetime('2001-01-01 01:00:00', '+' || id || ' minutes'), updated_at = datetime('2001-01-01 01:00:00', '+' || id || ' minutes') WHERE created_by LIKE 'agent:%'
